rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the single fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item. Part III amounts split into the peso comb and 2-slot centavo comb on the item's row (negative amounts stay blank, like every split-money sheet). Schedule 1 cells are single text cells and print the official text (1,234.50); on the printed sheet rows 1-3 (XM010) expose only Place, A, B and F, rows 4-8 expose Place, C, D and F, and the continuation omits the fixed rate column I for rows 1-8. Items 10 and 11 are not joined: the writer holds region/province/city codes, not printable names. The page 2 TIN comb (14 slots) is not joined: the writer holds the TIN in four parts. Part IV (payment details) has no writer values. Booleans fill X in the box left of the printed option.
